response.sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.Country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS avg_price FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country), dev AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_price, avg_price - (SELECT AVG(avg_price) FROM inv) AS deviation FROM inv), fin AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_price, deviation, deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS dev_minus_country_avg FROM dev) SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_price AS average_unit_price, deviation AS deviation_from_overall_average, dev_minus_country_avg AS deviation_minus_country_avg_deviation FROM fin ORDER BY (dev_minus_country_avg IS NULL), dev_minus_country_avg DESC LIMIT 10
